purpose: Standalone experimental Terran Authority architecture concept
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone experimental environment concept for the Terran Charter Authority in Stellar Syndicates.

Input image 1 is the PRIMARY AESTHETIC REFERENCE: preserve its exquisitely restrained architectural mood, pale mineral surfaces, rounded cantilevered terraces, vertical amber light, rugged cliff, still water and hazy mountain atmosphere. Create an original Authority location in this aesthetic.
Input image 2 is ONLY the faction emblem reference: a thin gold orbital ring intersected by three slender vertical spires of staggered heights. Use this motif accurately as an architectural insignia; do not copy its black backdrop or its image composition.

Scene: A monumental Terran Charter Authority coastal citadel embedded in a sheer mountain wall above a tranquil deep blue-grey inlet. An imposing civic seat of government: calm, affluent, ordered, ancient in its confidence yet quietly futuristic. A tall central rounded tower rises from several organically stepped, curved stone terraces, under a broad hovering-looking circular cornice. Monumental slender vertical window recesses glow with warm amber interiors. One huge sheltered entrance hall and a ceremonial waterfront terrace convey institutional scale. The main façade bears a beautifully crafted antique-gold Authority seal, integrated into the stone above the entrance; two restrained long navy banners carry the same small gold mark, no lettering. A few very small Authority officials in navy uniforms with ivory details give scale. Sparse mature wind-shaped trees and dark planting nestle in protected terraces. Misty mountain ranges and a tiny distant shoreline city recede across the water.

Art direction: the supplied reference's sophisticated pale-stone retro-futurist architecture, with softly rounded austere Art Deco forms and sculpted modernist masses. Warm ivory limestone and weathered off-white mineral concrete, subtle rain streaks, fine surface grain, muted silver and restrained aged-brass details, deeply recessed navy-graphite glazing. Believable engineering and exquisite material realism. Restrained narrow light strips integrated under terraces and inside tall windows, reflected softly in the water.

Composition: ONE finished square cinematic image, high resolution. Three-quarter exterior architectural view from just above the water; the citadel dominates the right and center, with tranquil water, a spacious hazy mountain vista and layered atmospheric depth opening to the left. Show enough of the building's base, waterline and crown to read its sculptural architecture. A convincing, monumental building in its natural landscape, not a cropped façade or a diagram.

Lighting: soft cool overcast twilight, luminous pearl-grey sky, pale desaturated blue-green atmospheric haze, warmly glowing amber windows. Match the reference's quiet realism, natural exposure, tactile stone, gentle soft shadows, restrained contrast. Architecture stays luminous and richly detailed.

Constraints: the reference aesthetic is the priority. No visible title, lettering, interface, watermark, collage or border. No busy machinery, guns, battle, neon cyberpunk or generic glass skyscrapers. Make one cohesive atmospheric scene.
